config_summary.note: This is a multimodal (VL) checkpoint -- pipeline_tag: image-text-to-text.

B_current_availability.total_parameters_approx: 428B total / ~23B activated (MoE, 128 local experts, 4 active per token, per model card and config.json)

C_immutable_identity_strategy.strategy: OPEN_WEIGHT -- registered pinned revision used for all future evaluation, never 'main'. Drift re-verified NO this phase.

D_license_or_terms.license_identifier: minimax-community (MiniMax Community License, HF tag category 'other')
D_license_or_terms.base_grant: Free of charge for NON-COMMERCIAL purposes -- to use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense, and/or provide copies of the Software.
D_license_or_terms.commercial_use_definition: Explicitly includes: (i) offering fee-based products/services incorporating the Software/derivatives; (ii) commercial use of APIs built on the Software; (iii) deployment/provision of the Software or derivatives that have been post-trained/fine-tuned/instruction-tuned/otherwise modified, FOR ANY COMMERCIAL PURPOSE.
D_license_or_terms.commercial_use_conditions: If commercial: must display 'Built with MiniMax M3' attribution; if resulting product/service revenue exceeds $20M/year, prior written authorization from MiniMax is required (api@minimax.io); below that, a one-time notice email suffices.
D_license_or_terms.evaluation_use: Non-commercial internal evaluation/comparison (running inference for internal scoring, not offering a fee-based product or commercially deploying a fine-tuned derivative) falls within the free non-commercial grant -- CLEAR for that specific use.
D_license_or_terms.commercial_evaluation: SEPARATE_PERMISSION_REQUIRED -- if ORNEUR's use of this reference is deemed to support a commercial product/service (revenue threshold $20M/year triggers written authorization), the commercial-use clause and its notice/authorization requirements apply.
D_license_or_terms.hosting: Permitted for non-commercial purposes under the base grant.
D_license_or_terms.fine_tuning: Permitted non-commercially under the base grant ('modify'); commercial deployment of a fine-tuned derivative falls under the Commercial Use definition above.
D_license_or_terms.derivative_work: Permitted non-commercially (see fine_tuning); commercial derivative deployment requires the Commercial Use conditions.
D_license_or_terms.output_storage: NOT ADDRESSED in the license text.
D_license_or_terms.synthetic_data_use: NOT ADDRESSED explicitly as a standalone term.
D_license_or_terms.distillation_teacher_use: NOT explicitly named ('teacher model' / 'synthetic data generation' do not appear), but commercially deploying a fine-tuned/distilled derivative falls under the Commercial Use definition's clause (iii). Using the model purely to generate distillation data WITHOUT commercial deployment of the result is not explicitly addressed -- a genuine gap, not a grant.
D_license_or_terms.prohibited_uses: Appendix bars: content violating law, military purposes, exploitation of minors, disseminating false/misleading info to cause harm, promoting discrimination/hate speech.
D_license_or_terms.status_rationale: For ORNEUR's actual intended use this phase -- internal, non-commercial Genesis frontier COMPARISON/evaluation, not a fee-based product and not commercial deployment of a fine-tuned derivative -- the license's non-commercial grant clearly covers it. Recorded CLEAR for EVALUATION_USE specifically; COMMERCIAL_EVALUATION and DISTILLATION/TEACHER_USE are recorded as separate, unresolved categories per D above (§9's mandatory separation).

E_reference_evaluation_admission.rationale: Identity resolved, license/terms CLEAR for the specific non-commercial evaluation use ORNEUR requires, no evidence-retention prohibition found (see F), and no access-path blocker exists for OPEN_WEIGHT self-host in principle (though impractical -- see K).

F_evidence_retention.rationale: The license does not prohibit retaining evaluation records (prompts/outputs/metadata) for internal, non-commercial research/audit purposes -- this falls within the broad non-commercial grant ('use, copy, modify... provide copies') and is not contradicted by any clause.

G_output_display_to_judges.rationale: Showing model outputs to internal ORNEUR judges as part of the same internal, non-commercial evaluation process is covered by the same non-commercial grant as F above -- this is not external redistribution to the public or a commercial product.

H_private_holdout_compatibility.rationale: No holdout prompts are authored this phase. Nothing in the license requires publication of prompts/outputs or prohibits confidential internal test material -- private holdout use, if it remains non-commercial internal evaluation, is not contradicted by the license terms found.

I_automated_evaluation_allowed.rationale: The LICENSE governs the open-weight artifact itself (self-host); if evaluation instead uses MiniMax's hosted API, that path's specific ToS on automated/batch evaluation was NOT confirmed this phase (see K -- first-party docs fetch was blocked by a .cn redirect). For a self-hosted evaluation path, the license itself does not prohibit automated evaluation.

J_commercial_product_evaluation_allowed.rationale: Same as D's commercial_evaluation finding -- the $20M/year revenue threshold and attribution/notice requirements apply if ORNEUR's use is deemed to support a commercial product.

first_party_api.endpoint: platform.minimaxi.com (international) -- a direct fetch to a documented endpoint path 302-redirected to platform.minimax.cn this phase; the .cn redirect target was NOT fetched out of caution (could not independently confirm it is an intended/safe destination rather than a doc misconfiguration)
first_party_api.official_status: EXISTS but first-party ToS/pricing NOT independently confirmed this phase due to the redirect
first_party_api.pricing: THIRD-PARTY-SOURCED ONLY (openrouter.ai / pricepertoken.com / developer.puter.com trackers, cross-referenced, NOT first-party-confirmed): ~$0.30/M input, $1.20/M output, $0.06/M cached-read tokens (Standard tier, <=512K input; described as a promotional 50% off a $0.60/$2.40 base); requests >512K input bill entire request at 2x; a 'Priority' service tier at 1.5x standard exists.
first_party_api.reasoning_mode: `thinking` parameter with three modes per model card: enabled (always reasons), adaptive (auto-decides), disabled (skips reasoning for latency)
first_party_api.openai_compatible_interface: NOT FIRST-PARTY-CONFIRMED this phase -- an Anthropic-compatible endpoint path was referenced in the redirect URL, suggesting multiple protocol-compatible endpoints exist, but this was not independently verified

self_host.basis: GENESIS_FRONTIER_COMPUTE_MATRIX.md: 428B params -> 11x 80GB-class GPUs at BF16, 6x at FP8, 3x at INT4 -- THEORETICAL_WEIGHT_FIT only (compute matrix notes MiniMax M3's 3x-80GB INT4 figure as the 'least prohibitive frontier candidate' among the six, but still not PRACTICAL_FRONTIER_EVALUATION_SERVING for a zero-owner-cash program). Compute matrix not redesigned this phase.

K_access_paths.access_preflight_rationale: License permits self-host for internal non-commercial evaluation, and self-host is the OPEN_WEIGHT reference's canonical access path -- but it requires a live, fresh zero-cash feasibility check (GPU cost) before any actual execution, per phase instruction (no live billing check authorized this phase).

L_zero_owner_cash_rationale: Self-host requires 3-11x 80GB-class GPUs depending on precision -- not zero-cash-feasible in any near-term sense without a dedicated compute grant. The hosted API is a paid, metered product (third-party-sourced pricing only) with no confirmed free tier. No live billing check performed or authorized.
M_rate_limit_quota_implications: NOT CONFIRMED for the hosted API (fetch blocked); self-host has no external rate limit but is compute-prohibitive.
N_reproducibility_limitations: Open-weight pin is fixed (FIXED_IMMUTABLE) -- strong reproducibility for the underlying model identity. `thinking` mode (enabled/adaptive/disabled) must be explicitly recorded per future evaluation call. Multimodal (VL) architecture -- future evaluation harness must confirm text-only request compatibility if Genesis evaluation is text-only.
O_mutable_api_identity_requirements: NOT_APPLICABLE -- OPEN_WEIGHT reference with a fixed immutable revision.

P_teacher_distillation_synthetic_data_ri.rationale: The license addresses commercial deployment of fine-tuned/distilled derivatives (triggers Commercial Use conditions) but does not explicitly grant or prohibit pure non-commercial teacher/distillation/synthetic-data-generation use. Per §10, teacher rights are never inferred merely because evaluation use is permitted. No teacher_use_evidence_reference exists.
